notes: Paths are relative to the repository root. 'phase' is the delivery_phases number (from claude_signage_crm_production_prompt.json) each file was introduced for. Files not listed here (node_modules, dist, .next, packages/db/generated, *.tsbuildinfo, lockfiles' internals) are build output or dependencies, not source.
